product.name: Monoprice IEEE-1394 FireWire i.LINK DV Cable 6P-6P M/M 3ft (Clear)
product.description: The IEEE 1394 serial interface is better known as FireWire®, FireWire 400, and i.LINK®, and is found on most Apple® Mac® computers since 1995. It is also commonly found on portable video cameras by companies such as Sony®.This cable features male 6-pin "alpha" connectors on each end and supports data transfer rates up to 400Mbps.Apple, Mac, and FireWire are trademarks of Apple Inc, registered in the U.S. and other countries.
